title: And down the shelving shore flabbily, their splayed feet sinking in the silted sand
html_source:
Rendering the shore bodily thus female.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Alliteration using the letter “S” also evokes a swaying/curved image when the line is read. Possibly alluding to the female body as well?

 See now. There all the time without you: and ever shall be, world without end. 

 They came down the steps from Leahy's terrace prudently, Frauenzimmer:
anchor.suffix: Like me, like Algy, coming down to our mighty mother. Number one swung lourdily her midwife's bag, the other's gamp poked in the beach. From the liberties, out for the day. Mrs Fl
